title: The support-localization triangle of a complex: the construction
statement:
Fix the closed–open pair of
supported sections. For a bounded
below complex $K$, choose the specified
K-injective resolution
$K\to I(K)$, with injective terms. Put

$$
A(K)=s_*s^!I(K),\quad B(K)=I(K),\quad C(K)=j_*j^*I(K).
$$

Let $u:A(K)\to B(K)$ be the inclusion. The cone complex is
$\operatorname{Cone}(u)^m=B(K)^m\oplus A(K)^{m+1}$, with differential
$d(b,a)=(d_Bb+u(a),-d_Aa)$. This construction specifies the maps; it does not identify
ordinary restriction $s^{-1}$ with the derived functor $Rs^!$.

lean.statement:
noncomputable def supportLocalizationTriangle (hjs : Set.range s.base = (Set.range j.base)ᶜ)
    (I : CochainComplex (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology A) ℤ) [∀ n, Injective (I.X n)] :
    Pretriangulated.Triangle (DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology A)) :=
  DerivedCategory.triangleOfSES (shortExact_supportsShortComplex A j s hjs I)
lean.note: The upstream support-localization construction is the canonical triangle construction used by this item; its declaration supplies the triangle object and cone map. The pro-etale/ringed-site generalization in the blueprint is represented by the compatibility predicates in the item module.
